A '''tomato''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] that could be eaten. Youth gangs like [[Benthar's Boys]] and the [[Vibroblade gang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]] threw them at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence on the world.
